snippet.title: Polterguys: Possession Party – Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
In Polterguys: Possession Party, it’s all about sneaky possessions, sabotaging your friends, and staying one step ahead of the monster chasing you down. Possess everything from everyday objects to quirky toys and use them to escape, outsmart, or mess with your opponents.

With up to 8-player online matches, local split-screen play, and plenty of ways to customize your personal haunt, Polterguys brings fast-paced, chaotic fun to every game session. Unlock costumes, take on challenges, and race up the leaderboards to prove you’re the top Polterguy.

Polterguys launches on April 17, 2025, for PS4, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam.
Wishlist now and get ready to possess everything!

Check out the demo and wishlist on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1043520/Polterguys_Possession_Party/
